selected_problem: Fresh-main ChangesetStore.stage rejects duplicate canonical targets and existing non-directory ancestors, but two new changes could still target an ancestor path and its descendant (for example node and node/child.txt). Both stage preflights pass against the original empty workspace, then sequential apply necessarily creates a file/directory collision after an earlier mutation.
decision_basis: The defect is narrow and directly reproducible as a deterministic partial-apply path after all existing preflight checks pass.

Existing changeset policy already fails closed on duplicate canonical paths and existing non-directory ancestors, so rejecting an internally contradictory file hierarchy extends the same transaction invariant without inventing a new product architecture.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained unavailable with transient HTTP 502; this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.

pre_fix_reality.stage_preflight: both accepted when node did not yet exist
pre_fix_reality.apply_reproduction: first write materialized node as a file; second write then failed with filesystem ancestor collision, leaving the earlier mutation present

change: ChangesetStore.stage now rejects canonical path pairs where either target is an ancestor of the other with OVERLAPPING_CHANGE_PATH before any changeset artifact is staged.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: PASS: focused filesystem reproduction showed both ancestor preflights accepted and sequential apply failed after the parent-file mutation.
validation.focused_overlap_predicate: PASS in both parent-first and child-first order; unrelated paths remain accepted.

truth_boundary: This closes a deterministic hierarchical target collision before staging. It does not claim filesystem crash atomicity or compensation for arbitrary I/O failure during an otherwise valid multi-file apply, and it does not claim arbitrary complex repository synthesis is solved.
